name: awf
description: Agentic workflow skills: request a structured, language-agnostic code review of an exact change, resolve its findings with evidence, and record session learnings in agent instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Request and resolve code reviews, record session learnings
interface.longDescription: Pin the exact change, gather intent and constraints, and dispatch an independent read-only reviewer that reports separate verdicts and evidence-backed findings, then verify each finding against the current code and fix only what holds up. Record what a session taught in the right agent instruction file.
defaultPrompt: Review my changes since main against the spec.
Work through the review findings on this branch.
Record the learnings from this session.
